title: Replace e2e-agent MCP placeholder configuration with real harness wiring
observed_behavior: test/e2e-agent/harness.ts used a stdio-style placeholder MCP server URL, and smoke-test.ts skipped MCP execution pending additional configuration.
intended_behavior: The e2e-agent harness uses Bahia's real native HTTP MCP JSON-RPC endpoint by default, allows explicit external endpoint configuration, and fails closed on invalid or unreachable MCP configuration unless MCP is explicitly skipped.
authoritative_contract: Bahia exposes native MCP JSON-RPC over HTTP at POST /mcp and POST /api/v1/mcp. Tool discovery uses JSON-RPC method tools/list. This is documented in docs/user-guide/mcp-tools.md and docs/api.md and implemented by internal/api/handlers/mcp.go.
